blocks.text: Structural biology scientists ko beemari paida karne wale molecule par woh sahi jagah dhoondne mein madad deti hai jahan dawa kaam kar sake. Yeh jagahein aam tor par proteins hoti hain aur inhen drug targets kehte hain. In proteins ki 3D shakal dekh kar scientists woh khaas jagahein dhoondte hain jahan dawa jud kar protein ka kaam rok de. Misal: COVID-19 mein scientists ne coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) ke spike protein ko structural biology se parha. Yahi protein virus ko insani cells mein dakhil hone mein madad deta hai. Is ki 3D structure jaan kar scientists ne ise drug target mana, aur aisi vaccines aur dawaein banayin jo spike protein ko rok deti hain, taake virus mazeed cells ko infect na kar sake.
